title: 미래 시제(3) will과 be going to 비교 (I'll ~ / I'm going to ~)
goal: 그 자리에서 정한 일은 will, 미리 정해 둔 계획은 be going to로 구분해서 말할 수 있어요.

points.title: 지금 막 정했으면 will
points.body: 말하는 바로 그 순간에 정한 일은 will을 써요. 우유가 없다는 걸 듣고 "그럼 제가 사 올게요."라고 하면 I'll buy some.이에요.

points.title: 미리 정해 둔 계획이면 be going to
points.body: 말하기 전에 이미 마음먹은 일은 be going to를 써요. 아침부터 사기로 정해 뒀다면 I'm going to buy milk after work.라고 해요.

points.title: 도와줄게요 · 약속할게요는 will
points.body: "제가 해 드릴게요"(제안), "꼭 할게요"(약속)처럼 그 자리에서 하는 말은 보통 will이에요. I'll help you. / I'll call you tonight.

points.title: 예측: 눈앞의 증거면 be going to
points.body: 지금 보이는 증거로 '곧 ~하겠다' 할 때는 be going to를 써요. (Look at the sky. It's going to rain.) 그냥 내 생각으로 예측할 때는 I think ~ will을 많이 써요. (I think it will be hot tomorrow.)

points.title: 모양 정리
points.body: will은 주어와 상관없이 will + 동사원형이고, be going to는 am / is / are + going to + 동사원형이에요. 둘 다 뒤에는 동사원형이 와요. 두 개를 섞어서 will going to라고 쓰지 않아요.

formula: 지금 정함 · 제안 · 약속 → 주어 + will + 동사원형
미리 정한 계획 → 주어 + am / is / are + going to + 동사원형
눈앞의 증거로 예측 → It's going to + 동사원형
내 생각으로 예측 → I think + 주어 + will + 동사원형

mistakes.wrong: (전화가 울리자) I'm going to get it!
mistakes.why: 전화가 울리는 걸 보고 그 자리에서 정한 일이에요. 즉석에서 정한 일은 will을 써요.

mistakes.wrong: A: Why did you buy paint? B: I'll paint my room.
mistakes.right: A: Why did you buy paint? B: I'm going to paint my room.
mistakes.why: 페인트를 이미 사 뒀다는 건 미리 정한 계획이라는 뜻이에요. 이럴 땐 be going to가 자연스러워요.

mistakes.wrong: She will going to start work on Monday.
mistakes.right: She is going to start work on Monday.
mistakes.why: will과 be going to를 한 문장에 섞어 쓰는 실수예요. 둘 중 하나만 쓰세요.

examples.en: The phone is ringing. — I'll get it!
We're out of milk. — Oh, I'll buy some after work.
examples.ko: 우유가 다 떨어졌어요. — 아, 제가 퇴근하고 사 올게요.

examples.en: I'm going to buy a car next month. I've already saved the money.
examples.ko: 다음 달에 차를 살 거예요. 돈은 이미 모아 뒀어요.

examples.en: Your bag looks heavy. I'll carry it for you.
examples.ko: 가방 무거워 보이네요. 제가 들어 드릴게요.

examples.en: I'll call you tonight. I promise.
Look at the sky. It's going to rain.
We're going to travel around Tasmania in December.

examples.ko: 당신은 멜버른을 정말 좋아하게 될 것 같아요.

quiz.sentence: A: I'm hungry. B: I ___ make you a sandwich.
choices: will
am
going to
will to
quiz.ko: A: 배고파요. B: 제가 샌드위치 만들어 줄게요.
quiz.why: 그 자리에서 하는 제안이니까 will + 동사원형.

quiz.sentence: I've got a ticket. I'm going ___ see a concert on Friday.
choices: will
for
to
at
quiz.ko: 표가 있어요. 금요일에 콘서트 보러 갈 거예요.
quiz.why: 미리 정한 계획은 be going to + 동사원형. to를 빠뜨리면 안 돼요.

quiz.sentence: Look at that dark cloud! It's going to ___.
choices: rains
rain
raining
rained
quiz.ko: 저 먹구름 좀 봐요! 비가 오겠어요.
quiz.why: 눈앞의 증거로 예측할 때 It's going to + 동사원형.

quiz.sentence: She ___ going to start a new job next week.
choices: will
are
do
is
quiz.ko: 그녀는 다음 주에 새 일을 시작할 거예요.
quiz.why: She는 is going to. will going to처럼 섞어 쓰지 않아요.

quiz.sentence: I think it ___ be sunny tomorrow.
choices: is
will
going
does
quiz.why: 내 생각으로 예측할 때 I think + 주어 + will + 동사원형.

choices: I'll gets it!
I'm go to get it!
I will to get it!
I'll get it!
quiz.why: 그 자리에서 정한 일은 I'll + 동사원형.

quiz.ko: 우리는 내년에 케언즈로 이사할 거예요. (이미 정한 계획)
quiz.answer: We're going to move to Cairns next year.
choices: We're going to move to Cairns next year.
We're going to moving to Cairns next year.
We going to move to Cairns next year.
We will going to move to Cairns next year.
quiz.why: 미리 정한 계획은 We're going to + 동사원형.

quiz.answer: I'll call you tomorrow morning. I promise.
choices: I'll calling you tomorrow morning. I promise.
I'm call you tomorrow morning. I promise.
I'll call you tomorrow morning. I promise.
I will to call you tomorrow morning. I promise.

quiz.answer: Look at that man. He's going to fall!
choices: Look at that man. He's going to falls!
Look at that man. He going to fall!
Look at that man. He's going to fall!
Look at that man. He's going fall!
quiz.why: 눈앞에 보이는 상황으로 예측하니까 He's going to + 동사원형.

quiz.answer: I'm going to paint my room this weekend.
choices: I'm going to paint my room this weekend.
I'm going to painting my room this weekend.
I will going to paint my room this weekend.
I'm going paint my room this weekend.
quiz.why: be going to + 동사원형. will과 섞지 않고, to도 빠뜨리지 않아요.

quiz.prompt: A가 "We don't have any bread."라고 했어요. B의 대답으로 맞는 문장을 고르세요.
quiz.answer: Oh, I'll get some from the shop.
choices: Oh, I'll gets some from the shop.
Oh, I'm get some from the shop.
Oh, I will to get some from the shop.
Oh, I'll get some from the shop.
quiz.why: 듣고 바로 정한 일이니까 I'll + 동사원형.

quiz.answer: Are you going to visit your family in Korea?
choices: Do you going to visit your family in Korea?
Are you going to visit your family in Korea?
Are you going to visiting your family in Korea?
Will you going to visit your family in Korea?
quiz.why: be going to 질문은 Are you going to + 동사원형 ~?
